page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.large is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon 8369B core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The processor operates at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz and includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks show average single-core capabilities but limited multi-core scaling. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score of 1858.29 and Geekbench single-core score of 1559.0 both rank in the average tier. However, multi-core benchmarks are constrained by the dual-thread single-core hardware layout, resulting in a poor multi-core stress-ng score of 1932.77 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 1813.0. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 14.89 GB/sec and 13.52 GB/sec respectively.

This hardware profile represents an entry-level compute tier with dedicated CPU resources, offering a predictable performance profile compared to shared-core alternatives. It is suitable for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic text processing, and simple web serving. It is less suited for memory-intensive databases, multi-threaded compilation, or complex parallel processing tasks due to its constrained memory capacity and poor multi-core scaling.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.large is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring 2 vCPUs and 4.0 GB of RAM, powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance allocates dedicated CPU resources with hyper-threading across a single physical core. It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks indicate average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1858.29, but poor multi-core scaling and memory bandwidth due to the single physical core constraint. This instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic text processing, and low-traffic web serving.
